summary: On April 29, 2026, FTAI Infrastructure Inc. (FIP) entered into an equity purchase agreement to sell Long Ridge Energy & Power LLC to MARA USA Corporation for a base purchase price of $1.512 billion. The transaction includes customary representations, warranties, and covenants, with closing subject to regulatory approvals including FERC and HSR clearance.
why_it_matters: This $1.5B acquisition represents a significant transaction in the energy infrastructure sector, with MARA Holdings expanding its asset portfolio through acquisition of natural gas-fired power generation assets.
market_structure_context: The transaction involves railroad-related assets requiring Surface Transportation Board approval and includes provisions for reorganization of certain subsidiaries.
